caption:
Salesforce stock fell 9.4% today with no company news, leading a software sell-off a day before Anthropic prices its IPO. ServiceNow, Atlassian and Workday fell too. The odd part: about 45% of Salesforce's $11.3B investment portfolio is its Anthropic stake.
